style_name: Extreme Survival Physiology (Clean 2D Digital Vector Cartoon Stickman)

acts.name: The Trigger & Biological Inversion Hook
acts.goal: The tipping point: core temperature plunges, oxygen cuts off. The biological inversion where the body's survival mechanism turns into a deadly trap.

acts.name: The Compensation Phase
acts.goal: Extreme sacrifice of peripheral circulation (vasoconstriction, shivering thermogenesis) to keep brain and heart alive.

acts.name: The Biological Trap
acts.goal: Compensation collapses into terminal pathology: nitrogen narcosis, paradoxical undressing, cellular dehydration, blood acidosis.

acts.name: The Final Verdict
acts.goal: Absolute cellular threshold, forensic autopsy findings, and modern medical science takeaways on human survival limits.

flow.character_guide: Minimalist stickman explorer with thin black stick limbs, a smooth off-white round head with expressive cartoon face, wearing a thick winter parka with smooth fabric gradient shading and soft fur trim, warm mittens, and insulated boots.
flow.look: Clean 2D digital vector cartoon illustration, modern webcomic aesthetic, bold smooth black outlines, flat cel-shading with smooth vibrant color gradients, polished vector finish. Minimalist stickman explorer with thin black stick limbs, a smooth off-white round head with expressive cartoon face, wearing a thick winter parka with smooth fabric gradient shading and soft fur trim, warm mittens, and insulated boots, holding a glowing warm copper hurricane lantern. Environment: icy dusk snow mountain ridge, gentle blizzard fog, warm amber lantern light casting radial glowing gradients onto snow surfaces and character. Layered atmospheric depth, clean cinematic composition. Single continuous 16:9 widescreen frame. Single camera view. Absolutely NO comic book panels, NO multi-panel grids, NO split screens, NO borders.

editorial.voice: Investigative documentary baritone narrator. Authoritative, calm, clinical yet intensely vivid with subtle dry deadpan wit. Treats audience as intelligent adults. Short punchy sentences under 15 words.

hook_protocol.zero_fluff: Never open with welcomes, 'Have you ever wondered', or historical overviews.
hook_protocol.first_sentence: Sentence 1 (0:00-0:06) must contrast a natural biological defense with its deadly reality. E.g., 'At minus twenty degrees, your brain doesn't die of cold. It dies of panic.'
hook_protocol.the_stakes: Line 0:06-0:30 establishes the fatal organ breakdown threshold within 30 seconds.

rules: Cite cellular chemistry, core temperature thresholds in Celsius/Fahrenheit, electrolyte shifts, and heart rate decelerations.
Ground scenes in visceral sensory reality: metallic taste of hypoxia, silent numbness of freezing nerve fibers, deceptive warmth of paradoxical undressing.
Use physical analogies: metabolic heat dissipation compared to a leaking radiator, arterial constriction to a closed dam.
Structure follows the 4-act hour-by-hour collapse: Trigger -> Compensation -> Biological Trap -> Final Verdict.

composition_rules: Foreground Left (1/3 of frame): Close-up bust of stickman explorer with exaggerated expression (shivering, eyes wide with cold shock, ripping parka)
Background Right: Visually exaggerated extreme environment (howling snow blizzard, frozen ice cavern, dark abyss)
Upper Third: Clean negative space for bold 2-3 word yellow text hook
STRICT: Absolutely NO text, words, letters, logos, banners in the image generation prompt
